ledger: 00:00–00:09.75: One continuous exterior shot of a station wagon on a desert road; connected spaces are the passenger cabin and the surrounding outdoors.
00:00–00:03: The hood is ahead of the cabin; the front windshield sits above its rear edge. The near-side front door and side window are behind the windshield pillar, beside the exterior mirror.
00:00–00:09.75: Views through the vehicle windows show dark seats and the same desert surroundings; no contradictory far-side location is visible.
00:00–00:09.75: A woman holds her upper body outside the cabin with crossed forearms resting on the hood, ahead of the windshield pillar rather than through the side-door window.
00:06: The closer view shows her torso occupying the front windshield boundary directly above the hood; windshield glass and a wiper remain visible immediately beside her.
00:00–00:09.75: No door opens and no complete entry, exit, or traversal is shown; the woman maintains the same position as the camera approaches.

findings.entity: Front windshield opening and woman's position
findings.description: The woman's torso projects out through the front windshield area with her forearms on the hood. The near-side door window is separately visible behind the windshield pillar, so it cannot account for this position. The windshield meets the hood beneath her, with glazing and a wiper beside her, but no corresponding open panel or aperture is shown to accommodate her body.
